title: Macros cannot reuse saved actions
label: MISSING vs ZOHO
date: TAVI 9 Nov 2026 (live) · Zoho: help article (live Zoho Desk did not load on this network)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · Setup › Macros › New Macro › Add action (not saved)

panels.caption: TAVI: a macro's actions are built inline only (1). There is no "use a saved action" choice here, although workflow rules have one.
Zoho Desk help, Macros: alerts, tasks, field updates and custom functions made in a macro are kept under Automation and can be reused and edited (1).

rows: Reusing an action in several macros
Actions created for a macro are listed and can be picked again in other macros.
Each macro defines its actions inline; nothing can be picked from saved actions.
